naics.resolved_name: AI Security Initiative, Center for Long-Term Cybersecurity, University of California, Berkeley
naics.description: The AI Security Initiative is a research program within the Center for Long-Term Cybersecurity (CLTC) at the University of California, Berkeley, focused on studying security risks and policy implications of advanced AI systems. This record represents a comment jointly submitted by three researchers affiliated with that initiative rather than by the university administration itself. CLTC is a research center within Berkeley's School of Information.
naics.justification: The commenters are researchers at a center within a degree-granting university, and NAICS codes a university research center under the parent institution's higher-education code.
naics.category_justification: The AI Security Initiative is a research unit of UC Berkeley, a public research university, and the comment was submitted in that institutional research capacity.

naics.description: Squire Patton Boggs is a large international law firm, formed through the 2014 merger of Squire Sanders and Patton Boggs, providing legal services and government-relations/lobbying advice across many practice areas including technology and regulatory policy. Its Washington, D.C. office is well known for federal lobbying and public-policy work. The firm represents corporate, association, and government clients in legislative and regulatory matters.
naics.justification: Squire Patton Boggs's primary activity is providing legal and lobbying services as a law firm, directly matching this code.
naics.category_justification: As a for-profit law firm, it is coded business/industry, though its AI-policy comment may have been submitted on behalf of an unnamed client rather than reflecting the firm's own stake.

naics.description: Lenovo (United States) Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of Lenovo Group Limited, a multinational technology company headquartered in Hong Kong/Beijing that designs and manufactures personal computers, laptops, servers, smartphones, and other computing hardware. Lenovo is one of the world's largest PC vendors, having acquired IBM's ThinkPad business in 2005 and Motorola Mobility in 2014. It also provides data center and AI-infrastructure hardware through its enterprise business group.
naics.justification: Lenovo's primary activity is designing and manufacturing computers and computing hardware, directly matching this code.
naics.category_justification: Lenovo (United States) Inc. is the U.S. arm of a publicly traded, for-profit multinational technology manufacturer.

naics.description: The Semiconductor Industry Association (SIA) is a U.S. trade association representing semiconductor manufacturing and design companies. It advocates for federal policies on export controls, R&D funding, tax policy, and supply-chain resilience affecting the semiconductor industry, and publishes industry data such as global sales statistics. Its members include major U.S. chipmakers and semiconductor equipment companies.
naics.justification: SIA's core activity is representing semiconductor companies' collective policy and regulatory interests, matching the trade/business-association code rather than a manufacturing code.
naics.category_justification: SIA is a membership-based trade association advocating for the semiconductor industry's shared interests.

naics.description: Applied Materials, Inc. is a publicly traded American company that designs, manufactures, and services equipment used in the fabrication of semiconductors, displays, and related electronic devices. It is one of the world's largest suppliers of semiconductor manufacturing equipment, serving chipmakers worldwide. The company also provides related software and services for chip-fabrication process control.
naics.justification: Applied Materials' primary activity is manufacturing equipment used in semiconductor fabrication, directly matching this code.
naics.category_justification: Applied Materials is a publicly traded, for-profit semiconductor-equipment manufacturer commenting on its own commercial and regulatory interests.

naics.description: KLA Corporation is a publicly traded American company that designs and manufactures process-control and yield-management systems used in semiconductor and electronics manufacturing, including inspection and metrology equipment. It serves semiconductor chipmakers and equipment suppliers worldwide and is a major player in the chip-fabrication equipment industry alongside firms like Applied Materials and Lam Research. KLA was formerly known as KLA-Tencor.
naics.justification: KLA's primary activity is manufacturing process-control and inspection equipment for semiconductor fabrication, matching this code.
naics.category_justification: KLA Corporation is a publicly traded, for-profit semiconductor-equipment manufacturer commenting on its own commercial and regulatory interests.

naics.description: The National Defense Industrial Association (NDIA) is a U.S. trade association representing companies and individuals in the defense and national-security industrial base. It advocates on defense acquisition, procurement, and technology policy, and hosts conferences and working groups connecting defense contractors with government officials. Its membership spans large defense primes, smaller suppliers, and individual defense-industry professionals.
naics.justification: NDIA's core activity is representing defense-industry member companies' collective policy and business interests, matching the trade/business-association code.
naics.category_justification: NDIA is a membership-based trade association advocating for the defense industrial base's shared interests.

naics.description: The Center for a New American Security (CNAS) is a nonpartisan nonprofit think tank based in Washington, D.C., focused on national security and defense policy research, including work on artificial intelligence, technology competition, and military innovation. It publishes reports and convenes events to inform policymakers on defense and foreign-policy issues. CNAS does not represent a dues-paying membership but operates as an independent research institution.
naics.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
naics.justification: CNAS's primary activity is producing national-security and defense-policy research and analysis, matching this R&D code.
naics.category_justification: CNAS is an independent nonprofit policy research institution rather than a membership or trade body.

naics.resolved_name: Mercatus Center at George Mason University
naics.description: The Mercatus Center is a free-market-oriented research and educational center affiliated with George Mason University, producing policy research and commentary on regulatory, economic, and technology issues, including AI regulation. It operates with its own donor funding and governance while being housed at the university, functioning similarly to an independent think tank. It also runs graduate fellowship and training programs for students and scholars.
naics.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
naics.justification: Mercatus's primary activity is producing economic and regulatory policy research, matching this R&D code.
naics.category_justification: Although housed within George Mason University, Mercatus operates as a separately funded policy research organization rather than as the university's own degree-granting teaching function, so it is coded as an affiliated nonprofit think tank.

naics.resolved_name: Institute for AI Policy and Strategy (IAPS)
naics.description: The Institute for AI Policy and Strategy (IAPS) is an independent nonprofit think tank that conducts research on frontier AI governance and risk-reduction strategy, publishing analysis aimed at informing policymakers. It is funded in part by Rethink Priorities and focuses on issues such as international AI governance, compute regulation, and frontier model oversight. IAPS has emerged as one of several newer AI-policy-focused research organizations in Washington.
naics.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
naics.justification: IAPS's primary activity is producing AI governance and policy strategy research, matching this R&D code.
naics.category_justification: IAPS is an independent nonprofit policy research organization rather than a membership or trade body.

naics.description: TechFreedom is a Washington, D.C.-based nonprofit, nonpartisan technology policy think tank that advocates for light-touch, innovation-friendly regulation of the internet and emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence. It publishes legal and policy analysis, files regulatory comments, and engages in litigation on tech-policy issues such as antitrust, privacy, and content moderation. It generally favors free-market and free-speech-oriented approaches to technology regulation.
naics.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
naics.justification: TechFreedom's primary activity is producing technology-policy research, legal analysis, and advocacy, which fits this R&D code, though its litigation and advocacy work also has a strong advocacy component.

alternates.justification: TechFreedom actively campaigns and litigates on policy positions, which is a strong social-advocacy activity.
It engages in litigation, though this supports its advocacy mission rather than constituting a client-serving law practice.

naics.resolved_name: xD (Emerging Technologies Group), U.S. Census Bureau
naics.description: xD is an emerging-technologies group within the U.S. Census Bureau, part of the U.S. Department of Commerce, that applies data science and artificial intelligence to improve the delivery of government data services. It runs multidisciplinary teams of engineers, data scientists, and designers on projects such as privacy-enhancing technologies, and administers an Emerging Technology Fellowship program bringing technologists into federal service. xD partners with academic researchers and other federal agencies on applied AI projects.
naics.justification: xD is an internal innovation unit of a federal statistical agency performing general government support/technology functions, which NAICS captures under this public-administration support code rather than a private R&D or IT code.

alternates.justification: Fits as a general administrative/technology-support function within a federal agency.

naics.category_justification: xD is an internal unit of the U.S. Census Bureau, a federal statistical agency within the Department of Commerce.

naics.description: METR (Model Evaluation and Threat Research) is a nonprofit research organization that develops methods to evaluate frontier AI models for dangerous autonomous capabilities, such as the ability to self-replicate or conduct sophisticated cyberattacks. It works directly with leading AI developers, including OpenAI and Anthropic, to run pre-deployment capability evaluations and has published widely cited research on AI capability trends. It emerged from earlier work at the AI safety group ARC Evals.
naics.naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)
naics.justification: METR's primary activity is technical research developing and running empirical AI-capability evaluations, which falls under this general engineering/physical-science R&D code in the absence of a dedicated computer-science R&D code.

alternates.naics_title: Other Scientific and Technical Consulting Services
alternates.justification: METR's evaluation work with AI labs resembles technical consulting, though it operates as a research nonprofit rather than a fee-based consultancy.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
alternates.justification: Its work informs AI governance and policy discussions, a social-science-adjacent application of its technical research.
Ruled out as secondary; METR's core output is technical evaluation research, not advocacy campaigning.

naics.category_justification: METR is a nonprofit research organization conducting technical AI-safety evaluation work in the public interest.

naics.description: AI LA (also styled AI.LA) is a Los Angeles-based 501(c)(3) nonprofit community organization supporting the STEAM (science, technology, engineering, arts, and mathematics) community, focused on driving innovation through education, conversation, and collaboration around artificial intelligence. Since 2016 it has hosted panel discussions, workshops, hackathons, and symposia exploring AI's impacts on society, including ethics, bias, and privacy. It engages members through a mix of events, media, and workforce-development programming.
naics.justification: AI LA's primary activity is organizing community education, networking, and public-engagement events around AI, matching this civic/social-organization code.

alternates.justification: Its programming has a strong educational-workshop component, though it functions more as a community/membership organization than a formal educational-services provider.

alternates.naics_title: Other Similar Organizations (except Business, Professional, Labor, and Political Organizations)
alternates.justification: A generic catch-all considered but less precise than the civic/social-organization code.
Ruled out as secondary; AI LA's core activity is community education and events, not policy advocacy campaigning.

naics.category_justification: AI LA is a registered 501(c)(3) community nonprofit focused on public education and engagement rather than a trade or professional membership body.

naics.description: The Association for Computing Machinery (ACM) is the world's largest professional membership society for computing professionals and academics, founded in 1947. It publishes computing research journals and conference proceedings, sets professional and ethical standards for the field, and advocates on technology-policy issues including AI, through its Technology Policy Council. It also administers major awards, including the ACM A.M. Turing Award.
naics.justification: ACM's core activity is operating a professional membership society for computing professionals, including publishing, standards-setting, and advocacy, matching this professional-organization code.
naics.category_justification: ACM is a membership-based professional society representing computing professionals' collective interests, including through policy advocacy.

Founded in 1979, it organizes major academic conferences (such as the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence), publishes research journals, and engages in public-policy discussions on AI. Its membership consists primarily of AI researchers and academics.
naics.justification: AAAI's core activity is operating a professional/scientific membership society for AI researchers, including conferences, publishing, and policy engagement, matching this code.
naics.category_justification: AAAI is a membership-based professional society representing AI researchers' collective scientific and policy interests.

naics.resolved_name: Joint comment of AAAI, ACM, CRA, and SIAM
naics.description: This record represents a joint comment submitted by four U.S. professional and scientific membership societies in computing and mathematics: the Association for the Advancement of Artificial Intelligence (AAAI), the Association for Computing Machinery (ACM), the Computing Research Association (CRA), and the Society for Industrial and Applied Mathematics (SIAM). Each organization independently represents researchers, academics, and practitioners in its respective field and jointly advocates on federal science, computing, and AI policy issues. The joint filing reflects a shared interest among these societies in AI research funding and policy.
naics.justification: All four co-signing organizations are professional/scientific membership societies whose primary activity is representing researchers and academics, matching this professional-organization code.
naics.category_justification: The filing is a coalition of membership-based professional societies jointly representing their members' shared scientific-policy interests.

naics.description: The American Meteorological Society (AMS) is a professional scientific society founded in 1919 that promotes the development and dissemination of information on the atmospheric, oceanic, and hydrologic sciences. It publishes peer-reviewed journals, hosts scientific conferences, sets professional certification standards for meteorologists, and engages in public-policy discussions on weather, climate, and related technologies including AI applications in forecasting. Its membership includes scientists, forecasters, educators, and students.
naics.justification: AMS's core activity is operating a professional/scientific membership society for meteorologists and related scientists, matching this code.
naics.category_justification: AMS is a membership-based professional society representing atmospheric and related scientists' collective interests.

naics.description: Anduril Industries is a privately held American defense-technology company, founded in 2017, that designs and manufactures autonomous systems for military and homeland-security applications, including sensor towers, unmanned aircraft, counter-drone systems, and AI-enabled command-and-control software. It has grown rapidly as a venture-backed alternative to traditional defense contractors, supplying systems to the U.S. military and allied governments. Anduril's Lattice software platform integrates sensor and autonomy data for battlefield awareness.
naics.naics_title: Search, Detection, Navigation, Guidance, Aeronautical, and Nautical System and Instrument Manufacturing
naics.justification: Anduril's primary hardware products are sensor, detection, and autonomous guidance/surveillance systems for defense use, matching this code, though it also has a significant software/AI component.

It offers undergraduate and graduate degrees and conducts extensive scientific research, including through its management of NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory. Caltech faculty and researchers have submitted comments on federal AI and technology policy matters.
naics.justification: Caltech's primary activity is degree-granting higher education and academic research, matching this code.

Established in 2017 under founding director Larry Lewis, the center conducts research and analysis on the use of autonomy and AI in military operations and national/homeland security. CNA's broader work spans decades of support to defense, homeland security, and other federal agencies.

naics.description: General Electric (GE) is a historic American multinational conglomerate that, as of its more recent corporate history, has focused primarily on aviation (jet engines), power generation equipment, and renewable energy, having spun off its healthcare and energy businesses into separate public companies. GE's aviation unit designs and manufactures aircraft engines, while its legacy power business manufactures gas and steam turbines. The company has been a long-standing participant in federal technology and AI policy discussions.
naics.naics_title: Aircraft Engine and Engine Parts Manufacturing

alternates.naics_title: Turbine and Turbine Generator Set Units Manufacturing

alternates.naics_title: Instruments and Related Products Manufacturing for Measuring, Displaying, and Controlling Industrial Process Variables
alternates.justification: GE also has historically manufactured industrial control and instrumentation products, though this is a smaller share of its business than aviation or power.

naics.category_justification: General Electric is a publicly traded, for-profit industrial manufacturing conglomerate commenting on its own commercial interests.

HIMSS engages federal policymakers on issues such as AI in healthcare, interoperability, and health data policy.
naics.justification: HIMSS's core activity is representing health IT professionals' and member organizations' collective interests, including industry-facing advocacy and conferences, fitting the business-association code, though it also has substantial professional-society characteristics.

HIMSS offers substantial training and certification programs, though this is secondary to its membership-representation mission.

It engages in federal policy advocacy on issues such as interoperability, telehealth, and health data regulation, including the use of AI in healthcare. It functions as an ad hoc policy coalition rather than a formal dues-based professional society.
naics.justification: HealthITNow's core activity is coordinating a coalition of stakeholder organizations to advocate for shared health-IT policy positions, fitting the business-association code, though it operates more loosely than a formal trade association.

naics.description: Indiana University is a public research university system headquartered in Bloomington, Indiana, with multiple campuses across the state offering undergraduate, graduate, and professional degree programs. It conducts extensive academic research, including in computing, data science, and health sciences, and has submitted comments on federal AI and technology policy matters through its faculty and administration. It is one of the larger public university systems in the United States.
naics.justification: Indiana University's primary activity is degree-granting higher education and academic research, directly matching this code.
naics.category_justification: Indiana University is a public, degree-granting research university commenting in its institutional capacity.

naics.naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)

naics.description: ISACA (formerly the Information Systems Audit and Control Association) is a global nonprofit professional association founded in 1969 and headquartered in Schaumburg, Illinois. It develops and administers professional certifications such as CISA and CISM and the COBIT governance framework for IT audit, cybersecurity, and risk-management professionals. ISACA has roughly 170,000 members organized into chapters across more than 180 countries.
naics.justification: ISACA's core activity is operating a membership-based professional association that certifies and represents IT audit and governance professionals, matching this code for professional organizations.

alternates.justification: Close alternative for membership organizations, but ISACA represents individual professionals rather than member businesses.
ISACA also provides substantial training and certification/testing services, an adjacent activity.

alternates.naics_title: Other Scientific and Technical Consulting Services
alternates.justification: ISACA publishes technical governance frameworks, though this is secondary to its membership function.

It conducts research and advocacy on topics including immigration, climate policy, technology, and governance, aiming to influence federal policymaking through direct engagement with legislators and agencies. It positions itself as ideologically independent, drawing on both libertarian and progressive policy traditions.
naics.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
naics.justification: The Niskanen Center's primary activity is producing public-policy research and analysis across social and economic issues, matching R&D in the social sciences.

It conducts and funds interdisciplinary research on decision-making processes and policy formation, spanning law, political science, and public administration. The Center also publishes the academic journal Policy Sciences and administers related research grants and prizes.
naics.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities

naics.description: Immuta, Inc. is a U.S.-based data-security company that provides a data-access-control and governance platform used by enterprises to automate data-privacy policy enforcement and secure sensitive data across cloud data platforms. Its software enables fine-grained access controls, data masking, and audit logging for data teams. Immuta has engaged in federal discussions on data privacy and AI governance.
naics.justification: Immuta's primary activity is developing and licensing its proprietary data-access-control and governance software platform.

alternates.naics_title: Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services
alternates.justification: Immuta's platform is often delivered as a managed service integrated with cloud data platforms.
Immuta may provide custom integration services for enterprise data environments.
Weaker fit relative to software publishing given its productized platform model.

naics.category_justification: Immuta is a for-profit, venture-backed data-security software company.

naics.description: Inpher, Inc. is a technology company, with roots in Switzerland and the U.S., that develops secure multi-party computation and privacy-preserving machine-learning software, marketed under its XOR platform. Its technology allows organizations to compute jointly on encrypted or distributed data without revealing the underlying data to each other. Inpher has contributed to federal discussions on privacy-enhancing technologies.
naics.justification: Inpher's primary activity is developing and licensing its proprietary secure multi-party computation software platform.

alternates.justification: Inpher may provide custom cryptographic-computation deployments for enterprise clients.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)
alternates.justification: Inpher's technology stems from significant applied cryptography research.

alternates.naics_title: Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services
alternates.justification: Weaker fit; not primarily an infrastructure-hosting provider.

naics.category_justification: Inpher is a for-profit venture-backed secure-computation software company.

naics.description: IQVIA Inc. is a large, publicly traded healthcare data-analytics and contract-research company formed by the 2016 merger of Quintiles and IMS Health. It provides clinical-trial management, real-world evidence, and advanced analytics services to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and life-sciences clients globally. IQVIA manages one of the largest healthcare databases in the world and applies AI/ML techniques to clinical and real-world patient data.
naics.naics_title: Research and Development in Biotechnology (except Nanobiotechnology)
naics.justification: IQVIA's core business includes managing and analyzing clinical-trial and life-sciences research on behalf of biopharmaceutical clients, which most closely aligns with life-sciences R&D services among the available codes.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)
alternates.justification: IQVIA's contract research and clinical-trial services could alternatively be classified under this broader physical/life-sciences R&D code.

alternates.naics_title: Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services
alternates.justification: A large share of IQVIA's revenue comes from healthcare data processing and analytics services rather than direct R&D.
Weaker fit; IQVIA is not primarily a diagnostic testing laboratory.

naics.category_justification: IQVIA is a large publicly traded for-profit contract-research and healthcare-analytics corporation.

naics.description: IXUP Limited is an Australian, publicly listed (ASX: IXU) technology company that provides a homomorphic-encryption-based data-collaboration platform called the Secure Data Engine. Its technology allows organizations to analyze sensitive datasets jointly without decrypting the underlying data, serving healthcare, finance, and government clients. IXUP is an approved cloud-services supplier to the Australian federal government.
naics.justification: IXUP's primary activity is developing and licensing its proprietary encrypted-data-analytics software platform.

alternates.naics_title: Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services
alternates.justification: IXUP's Secure Data Engine is delivered largely as a hosted data-processing service.
IXUP may provide custom integration services for government and enterprise clients.

alternates.naics_title: Other Scientific and Technical Consulting Services
alternates.justification: Weaker fit; not primarily an advisory firm.

naics.category_justification: IXUP is a publicly listed, for-profit Australian technology company.

naics.description: Juniper Networks, Inc. is a publicly traded U.S. networking hardware and software company, founded in 1996 and headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, that designs and sells routers, switches, and network-security products for service providers and enterprises. naics.justification: Juniper Networks' primary activity is designing and manufacturing data-networking equipment (routers and switches), which falls under the NAICS code covering data communications equipment manufacturing.

alternates.justification: A growing share of Juniper's business is network-management and AI-driven software (Mist AI), which could alternatively be classified as software publishing.

alternates.naics_title: Computer and Computer Peripheral Equipment and Software Merchant Wholesalers
alternates.justification: Reflects the distribution side of Juniper's hardware sales, though the company is primarily a manufacturer/designer rather than a wholesaler.

naics.category_justification: Juniper Networks is a publicly traded, for-profit networking-technology corporation.

naics.description: Karlsgate is a privacy technology company founded in 2020 and headquartered in Budd Lake, New Jersey. It develops the Karlsgate Identity Exchange, a software platform that lets companies collaborate on and match data without exposing personally identifiable information. alternates.justification: The platform could alternatively be viewed as bespoke integration/development work for clients.

alternates.naics_title: Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services

alternates.naics_title: Other Scientific and Technical Consulting Services
alternates.justification: Some of its work involves advisory support on data privacy strategy.

naics.category_justification: Karlsgate is a venture-backed, for-profit software company commenting in its own capacity.

naics.description: Knexus Research is a small, for-profit research and development company based in the Washington, D.C. area, incorporated in Virginia. naics.description: LeapYear Technologies was a San Francisco-based software company, founded in 2015, that built an enterprise platform for differentially private data analytics and machine learning on sensitive data. naics.description: Meta Platforms, Inc. is a technology company headquartered in Menlo Park, California, that operates Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and other social media and messaging platforms. naics.description: MOSTLY AI is a synthetic data software company founded in Vienna, Austria, with a U.S. presence, that generates statistically representative synthetic datasets to enable privacy-preserving analytics and AI model training. Its platform lets enterprises replace real sensitive data with artificial data that retains statistical patterns without exposing individual records. Its customers span financial services, insurance, telecommunications, and other data-intensive industries.
naics.justification: MOSTLY AI's core business is developing and licensing its own synthetic data generation software platform.

alternates.justification: Some client engagements may involve custom data-modeling work.

alternates.naics_title: Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services

naics.category_justification: MOSTLY AI is a for-profit software vendor commenting in its own capacity.

naics.description: NowVertical Group Inc. is a Toronto-based, publicly traded (TSXV: NOW) company that provides big data, analytics, and artificial intelligence software and services tailored to specific industry verticals. Founded in 2018, it operates across North America, Europe, and Latin America, offering data management, analytics, and AI applications to public and private sector clients. naics.justification: NowVertical's core offering is proprietary vertical-intelligence software, though it also delivers substantial custom services, making the code less than fully certain.

alternates.justification: The company performs significant custom software/data engineering work for clients.

alternates.naics_title: Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services
alternates.justification: Some offerings are delivered as hosted data services.

naics.category_justification: NowVertical is a publicly traded for-profit company commenting in its own capacity.

naics.description: Prifina Inc. is a San Francisco-based, venture-backed startup founded in 2019 that builds a personal data infrastructure platform allowing individuals to own and control data from their sensors, wearables, and other personal devices. Its platform enables developers to build applications on user-held data under a privacy-first, user-controlled model. More recently the company has focused on personal AI ('AI Twin') products built on this data infrastructure.

alternates.naics_title: Computing Infrastructure Providers, Data Processing, Web Hosting, and Related Services

alternates.naics_title: Other Scientific and Technical Consulting Services
alternates.justification: Weak fit, but the company does some advisory work around personal data strategy.

naics.description: Privacy Analytics Inc. is an Ottawa, Canada-based data anonymization and de-identification software and services company, now operating as part of IQVIA. naics.description: The Southern Poverty Law Center (SPLC) is a nonprofit legal advocacy organization headquartered in Montgomery, Alabama, founded in 1971. It engages in civil rights litigation, monitors hate groups and extremism, and conducts public education and policy advocacy on issues including racial justice and civil liberties. SPLC is funded primarily through donations and operates as a 501(c)(3) organization.
naics.justification: SPLC's primary activity is advocating for and litigating on behalf of civil rights and against hate-based extremism, matching the human-rights organization code.

alternates.justification: SPLC conducts substantial civil rights litigation, resembling legal services.
Its broader advocacy and public-education work overlaps with general social advocacy.
Not a substantive fit; included as a weak alternative only.

naics.category_justification: SPLC is a well-known 501(c)(3) nonprofit legal and civil rights advocacy organization.

naics.resolved_name: Office of the Attorney General of Florida
naics.description: The Florida Attorney General is the chief legal officer of the State of Florida, heading the Florida Office of the Attorney General. The office represents the state in legal matters, prosecutes certain criminal appeals and consumer-protection cases, issues legal opinions, and enforces state and consumer-protection law, including on data privacy and technology issues. The Attorney General is an elected statewide constitutional officer.
naics.justification: The Attorney General's office is primarily a government legal counsel and prosecution function, directly matching this Public Administration code.

alternates.justification: As a statewide elected constitutional officer, the AG's office also has general executive functions.

alternates.naics_title: Other Justice, Public Order, and Safety Activities
alternates.justification: Some of its consumer-protection and public-safety enforcement work is broader than pure legal counsel.
Weak fit; the AG's office is not a combined executive/legislative body.

naics.category_justification: This is a U.S. state-level government office (Florida state government).

naics.description: Xylem Inc. is a publicly traded water technology company headquartered in Washington, D.C., that designs and manufactures products for water and wastewater applications, including pumps, treatment systems, and analytics/monitoring equipment. Spun off from ITT Corporation in 2011, it serves utilities, industrial, commercial, and residential customers globally. Xylem also provides digital water-monitoring and data-analytics solutions.
naics.naics_title: Measuring, Dispensing, and Other Pumping Equipment Manufacturing
naics.justification: Xylem's largest product lines are pumps and fluid-handling equipment for water applications, matching this manufacturing code, though the company is diversified across treatment and analytics as well.

alternates.justification: Xylem also manufactures water-quality monitoring and analytical instruments.
Not a strong fit; Xylem manufactures equipment for water utilities rather than operating water utility systems itself.
Xylem also provides engineering and technical services alongside equipment manufacturing.

naics.category_justification: Xylem is a large publicly traded for-profit manufacturing and technology company commenting in its own capacity.

naics.description: Oregon State University is a public land-grant research university headquartered in Corvallis, Oregon. It offers undergraduate and graduate degree programs across a wide range of disciplines and conducts extensive research, including in engineering, computer science, and natural sciences. It is one of Oregon's largest public universities.
naics.justification: Oregon State University's primary activity is providing higher education and granting degrees, the defining activity of this code.
naics.category_justification: Oregon State University is an unambiguous public degree-granting university.

naics.resolved_name: National Institute of Standards and Technology (U.S. Department of Commerce)
naics.description: The National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) is a U.S. federal agency within the Department of Commerce, headquartered in Gaithersburg, Maryland. It develops measurement standards, technology guidelines, and conducts scientific research across fields including cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, physics, and engineering. NIST plays a leading role in shaping federal AI and privacy technical standards.
naics.naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)
naics.justification: NIST's core activity is conducting physical science, measurement, and engineering research; government research establishments producing R&D of this kind are generally coded to the corresponding private-sector R&D code rather than a Public Administration code, since sector 92 is reserved for uniquely governmental functions.

alternates.justification: The only R&D-specific Public Administration code, but it is narrowly defined for space research and does not fit NIST's broader measurement-science mission.

alternates.naics_title: Regulation, Licensing, and Inspection of Miscellaneous Commercial Sectors
alternates.justification: NIST also develops standards used in regulatory and commercial contexts.
NIST performs significant measurement, calibration, and testing standard-setting work.

naics.category_justification: NIST is an agency of the U.S. federal government (Department of Commerce).

naics.description: Boston University is a private research university headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts. It offers undergraduate, graduate, and professional degree programs across a broad range of disciplines and conducts extensive research, including in computer science and cryptography. It is one of the largest private universities in the United States.
naics.justification: Boston University's primary activity is providing higher education and granting degrees, the defining activity of this code.
naics.category_justification: Boston University is an unambiguous private degree-granting university.

naics.description: Labcorp (Laboratory Corporation of America Holdings) is a publicly traded clinical laboratory and drug development company headquartered in Burlington, North Carolina. It performs diagnostic testing services for physicians, hospitals, and patients, and also provides drug development and clinical trial support through its Labcorp Drug Development division. It is one of the largest clinical laboratory networks in the United States.
naics.justification: Labcorp's primary activity is performing diagnostic and clinical laboratory testing, the defining activity of this code.
naics.category_justification: Labcorp is a large publicly traded for-profit clinical laboratory company commenting in its own capacity.

naics.description: The University of Utah is a public research university headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah. It offers undergraduate, graduate, and professional degree programs and conducts extensive research, including in computer science, medicine, and engineering. It is the flagship public university of the state of Utah.
naics.justification: The University of Utah's primary activity is providing higher education and granting degrees, the defining activity of this code.
naics.category_justification: The University of Utah is an unambiguous public degree-granting university.

naics.description: 1cBio, Inc. is a discovery-stage, privately held biopharmaceutical company based in the San Francisco Bay Area, registered in 2022. It develops precision-medicine small molecules targeting cancer and rare diseases, including programs for hypophosphatasia and PARP1 inhibition. The company operates as a clinical-stage biotech without yet-approved marketed products.
naics.naics_title: Research and Development in Biotechnology (except Nanobiotechnology)
naics.justification: 1cBio's primary activity is discovery-stage drug research and development rather than manufacturing or selling an approved product, matching biotechnology R&D.

alternates.justification: If and when its candidate drugs reach commercialization, this manufacturing code would become more applicable.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)
alternates.justification: A broader life-sciences R&D code that could also apply.
Not a strong fit since 1cBio focuses on small molecules rather than biologics.

naics.category_justification: 1cBio is a privately held for-profit biopharmaceutical company commenting in its own capacity.

naics.description: The Computing Technology Industry Association (CompTIA) is a nonprofit trade association headquartered in Downers Grove, Illinois, representing the information technology industry. It develops vendor-neutral IT certifications, conducts industry research, and advocates on technology policy issues on behalf of its member companies and IT professionals. CompTIA is one of the largest IT trade and certification bodies in the world.
naics.justification: CompTIA's primary activity is representing and advocating for the collective interests of IT industry members, matching a business association.

alternates.justification: Its certification programs also serve an individual-professional credentialing function.
CompTIA develops and administers substantial IT training and certification content.

alternates.naics_title: All Other Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services
alternates.justification: Weak fallback; not a strong fit for its membership-based structure.

naics.category_justification: CompTIA is a membership-based trade association representing the IT industry's collective interests.

naics.description: The National League of Cities (NLC) is a Washington, D.C.-based nonprofit membership organization representing municipal governments across the United States. It advocates on behalf of cities, towns, and villages before Congress and federal agencies, provides research and technical assistance to local officials, and convenes municipal leaders on shared policy issues, including technology and AI. NLC represents thousands of member municipalities nationwide.
naics.justification: NLC's primary activity is representing and advocating for the collective interests of its member municipal governments, matching a membership association structure, though NAICS lacks a code specific to municipal leagues.

alternates.justification: Its membership consists entirely of government entities, giving it a quasi-governmental character.

alternates.naics_title: Other Similar Organizations (except Business, Professional, Labor, and Political Organizations)
alternates.justification: A general catch-all fit for a membership organization not cleanly matching a narrower code.
It engages in policy advocacy, though on behalf of member governments rather than a social cause.

naics.category_justification: NLC is a membership organization representing the collective interests of U.S. municipal governments rather than being itself a government unit.

normalized_name: rand and pardee rand graduate school
display_name: RAND and the Pardee RAND Graduate School

refs.raw_name: RAND and the Pardee RAND Graduate School

naics.resolved_name: RAND Corporation (parent of the Pardee RAND Graduate School)
naics.description: RAND Corporation is a nonprofit global policy think tank headquartered in Santa Monica, California, that conducts research and analysis to help improve policy and decision-making across defense, health, education, and technology issues. Its affiliated Pardee RAND Graduate School is the only PhD program embedded within a public policy research organization, training researchers through direct involvement in RAND's ongoing studies. Both operate under the RAND Corporation nonprofit structure.
naics.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
naics.justification: RAND's primary activity is conducting policy research across social, economic, and technology domains, and the Pardee RAND Graduate School shares RAND's research mission rather than functioning as an independent traditional university.

alternates.justification: Pardee RAND Graduate School is an accredited, degree-granting PhD program, giving it a genuine higher-education character.
RAND's policy work sometimes shades into advocacy, though its core activity is research rather than advocacy.

alternates.naics_title: Marketing Research and Public Opinion Polling
alternates.justification: RAND conducts some survey-based research, but this is not its defining activity.

naics.category_justification: RAND Corporation is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit research institute; its Pardee RAND Graduate School operates as part of RAND rather than as an independently chartered university.

naics.description: The Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) is a private research university headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts. It offers undergraduate and graduate degree programs with a strong focus on science, engineering, and technology, and conducts extensive research including in artificial intelligence, cryptography, and computer science. MIT is widely regarded as a leading global research university.
naics.justification: MIT's primary activity is providing higher education and granting degrees, the defining activity of this code.
naics.category_justification: MIT is an unambiguous private degree-granting university.

naics.description: Stanford University is a private research university headquartered in Stanford, California. It offers undergraduate, graduate, and professional degree programs across a broad range of disciplines and conducts extensive research, including in computer science, artificial intelligence, and cryptography. It is one of the world's leading research universities.
naics.justification: Stanford's primary activity is providing higher education and granting degrees, the defining activity of this code.
naics.category_justification: Stanford is an unambiguous private degree-granting university, referred to informally by its short name.

naics.description: Swarthmore College is a private liberal arts college headquartered in Swarthmore, Pennsylvania. It offers undergraduate degree programs across the humanities, social sciences, and natural sciences, including computer science. It is a highly selective, small residential liberal arts institution.
naics.justification: Swarthmore's primary activity is providing undergraduate higher education and granting bachelor's degrees, matching this code rather than the two-year Junior Colleges code.
naics.category_justification: Swarthmore is an unambiguous private degree-granting four-year college.

naics.description: Bayer AG is a German multinational life sciences company headquartered in Leverkusen, operating through pharmaceuticals, consumer health, and crop science (agricultural chemicals and seeds) divisions. It is one of the world's largest pharmaceutical and agrochemical companies. Bayer has submitted comments on US federal AI and technology dockets touching its pharmaceutical and agricultural businesses.
naics.justification: Bayer is best known globally for pharmaceutical manufacturing, though its Crop Science (agricultural chemicals) segment is comparably large, making the primary-activity call for the conglomerate genuinely close.

alternates.justification: Bayer's Pharmaceuticals division is a major global segment and the company is widely identified as a pharmaceutical manufacturer.

alternates.naics_title: Pesticide and Other Agricultural Chemical Manufacturing
alternates.justification: Bayer's Crop Science segment (agrochemicals and seeds, including the former Monsanto business) is its largest revenue segment.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in Biotechnology (except Nanobiotechnology)
alternates.justification: Bayer conducts substantial biotech R&D, though this is not its primary commercial activity.

naics.category_justification: Bayer AG is a publicly traded, for-profit multinational corporation.

naics.description: The Centre for Social Justice is a UK-based centre-right think tank founded in 2004 by Iain Duncan Smith, focused on researching and proposing policy solutions to poverty and social breakdown. It publishes reports and advocates for policy reforms in areas such as welfare, family stability, education, and addiction. It operates as an independent, mission-driven policy research organization.
naics.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
naics.justification: The organization's primary activity is producing social policy research and reports, which fits research and development in the social sciences.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
alternates.justification: Its core output is policy research on social issues.
It also functions as an advocacy body pushing for specific policy reforms.
It is a civic-minded membership-adjacent organization, though this fits less well than the research-focused codes.

naics.category_justification: It is an independent, mission-driven UK policy think tank/charity rather than a membership trade body, university, or government unit.

naics.resolved_name: SAG-AFTRA's Los Angeles New Technology Committee
naics.description: The Los Angeles New Technology Committee (LANTC) is a local committee of SAG-AFTRA, the labor union representing actors, broadcasters, and other media performers in the United States. The committee evaluates emerging technologies, including AI, that affect union members' work and reports findings to SAG-AFTRA's national leadership. It functions as an internal advisory body rather than an independent organization.
naics.naics_title: Labor Unions and Similar Labor Organizations
naics.justification: The committee is a sub-unit of SAG-AFTRA, a labor union, and its primary activity (representing member interests on technology issues) is an extension of the union's core labor-representation function.
naics.category_justification: As a component of a labor union, it shares SAG-AFTRA's membership-representation category.

naics.description: SHRM (Society for Human Resource Management) is a professional membership association for human resources practitioners, based in Alexandria, Virginia. It provides certification, education, research, and advocacy on workplace and HR policy issues. It is one of the largest professional associations in the world by membership.
naics.justification: SHRM's primary activity is operating a professional membership association for HR practitioners, which is the defining activity of this code.
naics.category_justification: SHRM is a membership-based professional association representing HR professionals' collective interests.

naics.resolved_name: GovAI (Centre for the Governance of AI)
naics.description: GovAI (the Centre for the Governance of AI) is an independent nonprofit research organization, originally incubated at the University of Oxford and now operating independently, dedicated to studying the governance of artificial intelligence. It conducts research and publishes policy recommendations on AI risk, regulation, and international coordination, and has submitted multiple comments to NIST on AI risk management frameworks. It is based in Oxford, UK.
naics.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
naics.justification: GovAI's primary activity is conducting policy and governance research on AI, which is social-science-oriented research and development.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
alternates.justification: Its output is AI governance and policy research.
It also advocates for specific AI governance approaches.

alternates.naics_title: All Other Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services
alternates.justification: A generic catch-all for policy consulting activity if research framing is rejected.

naics.category_justification: GovAI is an independent, mission-driven research nonprofit rather than a degree-granting university or trade association.

display_name: Africa Tech for Development Initiative - Africa4dev

naics.description: Africa4dev (Africa Tech for Development Initiative) is a Pan-African nonprofit organization promoting ethical and responsible use of technology and artificial intelligence across Africa. It builds partnerships with governments and institutions, runs training and digital-inclusion programs, and contributes to policy frameworks for AI governance. It has submitted comments to UN and US bodies on technology and human rights.
naics.justification: The organization's primary activity is advocacy and capacity-building for ethical technology use, which fits a social advocacy organization more than a pure research body.

alternates.justification: Its core mission is advocacy for responsible AI/tech policy and digital inclusion.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
alternates.justification: It also conducts and contributes to policy research on AI.
It runs technology training programs for individuals and communities.

naics.category_justification: It describes itself as a mission-driven nonprofit organization pursuing technology-for-development and advocacy goals rather than a formal membership trade body.

naics.description: New College Franklin is a small Christian liberal arts college located in Franklin, Tennessee, offering a Bachelor of Arts degree grounded in classical liberal arts education. It was incorporated in 2008 and accredited by the Transnational Association of Christian Colleges and Schools (TRACS). Its mission centers on discipleship and classical education for undergraduate students.
naics.justification: The organization's primary activity is providing undergraduate degree instruction, which directly matches this code.
naics.category_justification: New College Franklin is an accredited, degree-granting college.

naics.resolved_name: University of California, San Diego Health
naics.description: UC San Diego Health is the academic health system of the University of California, San Diego, operating hospitals, clinics, and specialty care centers in the San Diego region. It combines patient care with medical education and research as part of the UC San Diego School of Medicine. It jointly submitted AI policy comments with UCSF Health.
naics.justification: UC San Diego Health's primary activity is operating hospitals and providing patient care, matching this code even though it is academically affiliated.

alternates.justification: Its core activity is hospital-based patient care.

alternates.naics_title: Offices of Physicians (except Mental Health Specialists)
alternates.justification: It also operates outpatient physician clinics.
It is administratively part of a university's medical school and research mission.

naics.category_justification: UC San Diego Health is the health system of a public university (UC San Diego) rather than an independent hospital corporation.

naics.resolved_name: United States Office of Management and Budget
naics.description: The Office of Management and Budget (OMB) is a federal agency within the Executive Office of the President of the United States. It oversees the implementation of the President's budget, coordinates federal regulatory and management policy, and issues government-wide guidance, including on federal AI procurement and governance. It is headquartered in Washington, D.C.
naics.justification: OMB is an office of the chief executive (the President) providing executive management and oversight functions, matching the Executive Offices code.
naics.category_justification: OMB is a federal executive branch agency within the Executive Office of the President.

naics.description: Web research could not confidently identify which organization "SBC" refers to among several plausible candidates (e.g., Southern Baptist Convention, SBC Communications, or a small business coalition) given the docket context. No single entity could be confirmed as the commenter.
naics.justification: Without a confirmed identity, no primary activity can be established; this code is a low-confidence placeholder reflecting a generic membership/civic body guess.

alternates.justification: If SBC refers to a religious or civic body such as the Southern Baptist Convention, this code would be plausible.
If SBC is the Southern Baptist Convention, a religious-organizations code could fit better; this code could not be located in the reference list, so it is noted only as a consideration.
If SBC refers to the former SBC Communications (telecom, now part of AT&T), this code would apply, but nothing confirms this reading.

naics.category_justification: The abbreviation "SBC" is too generic and ambiguous to confidently identify the specific commenting organization.

naics.description: The University of Notre Dame is a private Catholic research university located in Notre Dame, Indiana. It offers undergraduate, graduate, and professional degree programs and conducts research across the sciences, engineering, humanities, and law. It has submitted comments on federal AI policy dockets.
naics.justification: The university's primary activity is degree-granting higher education, directly matching this code.
naics.category_justification: Notre Dame is an accredited, degree-granting private university.

naics.description: The Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) is a global professional association for internal audit professionals, headquartered in Lake Mary, Florida. It develops professional standards, certifications (such as the CIA), and continuing education for internal auditors. It also advocates on regulatory and governance policy affecting the auditing profession.
naics.justification: The IIA's primary activity is operating a professional membership and certification body for internal auditors, matching this code exactly.
naics.category_justification: The IIA is a membership-based professional association representing internal auditors' collective interests.

naics.description: The Toyota Technological Institute at Chicago (TTIC) is an independent, philanthropically endowed graduate computer science institute affiliated with the University of Chicago, conducting research and offering graduate education in computer science, including machine learning and AI.
naics.justification: TTIC is a degree-granting graduate institute, matching this education-services code.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)
alternates.justification: TTIC's core output is computer science research, which independently fits this R&D code.
Weak fit; TTIC is philanthropically endowed but operates as a degree-granting institute, not a grantmaker.
Not applicable; TTIC is an academic institute, not a software vendor.

naics.category_justification: TTIC is an independent, degree-granting graduate research institute.

naics.description: The U.S. Department of Commerce is a cabinet-level federal executive department that promotes economic growth and oversees agencies including NIST, NTIA, and the Census Bureau. It is a major source of federal AI policy activity through NIST's AI Risk Management Framework and NTIA's AI accountability work. It is headquartered in Washington, D.C.
naics.justification: As a cabinet department reporting to the President's executive branch, its administrative and policymaking function is best captured by the Executive Offices code, though a more specific public-administration code could apply to its individual sub-agencies.

alternates.justification: The Department operates as an executive-branch cabinet department implementing presidential policy priorities.
Commerce's core statutory mission is administering economic and trade programs.
A general catch-all for federal administrative support functions.

naics.category_justification: The U.S. Department of Commerce is a federal cabinet-level executive department.

naics.description: The National Apartment Association (NAA) is a US trade association representing owners, operators, and developers of apartment communities. It advocates on housing policy, provides education and industry data, and represents the rental housing industry before federal regulators, including on AI use in tenant screening. It is headquartered in Arlington, Virginia.
naics.justification: NAA's primary activity is representing the collective business interests of apartment owners and operators, matching the business association code.
naics.category_justification: NAA is a membership-based trade association representing the rental housing industry.

naics.description: The Information Technology and Innovation Foundation (ITIF) is a Washington, D.C.-based nonprofit think tank focused on technology policy, including AI, innovation, and productivity. It publishes research reports and advocates for policies supporting technology-driven economic growth. It has been an active commenter on multiple NIST AI rulemakings.
naics.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
naics.justification: ITIF's primary activity is producing technology and innovation policy research, matching social-science-oriented research and development.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
alternates.justification: Its core output is technology policy research and analysis.
It also actively advocates for specific technology policy positions.
A general catch-all for a nonprofit policy organization if the research framing is rejected.

naics.category_justification: ITIF is an independent, mission-driven think tank and not a membership-representation trade association, university, or government body.

naics.description: Aptiv PLC is a global automotive technology company that designs and manufactures electrical, electronic, and active safety systems for vehicles, including advanced driver-assistance and autonomous-driving technologies. It is headquartered in Dublin, Ireland with major US operations. It has commented on federal AI policy relevant to autonomous vehicle technology.
naics.naics_title: Motor Vehicle Electrical and Electronic Equipment Manufacturing
naics.justification: Aptiv's primary activity is manufacturing electrical and electronic vehicle components and systems, matching this code.

alternates.naics_title: Motor Vehicle Electrical and Electronic Equipment Manufacturing
alternates.justification: Aptiv's core products are vehicle electrical/electronic systems including sensors and software for ADAS.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)
alternates.justification: Aptiv invests heavily in autonomous-driving R&D, which is a significant part of its activity.
A broader auto-parts manufacturing code that could apply to some of its product lines.

naics.category_justification: Aptiv is a publicly traded, for-profit automotive technology manufacturer.

naics.resolved_name: Office of the Arkansas Attorney General
naics.description: The Office of the Arkansas Attorney General is the chief legal office of the State of Arkansas, representing the state in litigation and providing legal counsel to state agencies, including on consumer protection and technology policy matters. It is led by an elected state Attorney General. It has submitted comments on federal AI and technology dockets.
naics.justification: The Attorney General's office's primary activity is providing legal counsel and prosecuting cases on behalf of the state, directly matching this code.
naics.category_justification: This is a state government office (Arkansas state attorney general).

naics.description: Jenner & Block LLP is a large international law firm headquartered in Chicago, providing legal services across litigation, regulatory, and transactional practice areas, including technology and AI-related law. It represents corporate and other clients, and its attorneys have submitted comments on federal AI policy dockets, in some cases on behalf of clients. It has offices across major US cities.
naics.justification: The firm's primary activity is providing legal services, directly matching this code.
naics.category_justification: Jenner & Block is a for-profit law firm; where it commented on behalf of unnamed clients in an advisory capacity rather than expressing its own stake, that distinction is noted but does not change the category.

naics.description: Sysfleet Consulting LLC is a small IT services and consulting company based in Lynchburg, Virginia, specializing in robotic process automation (RPA), workflow modernization, and Microsoft-based digital transformation for government and enterprise clients. It is led by founder Sam Timothy. It has been recognized as a Microsoft AI Cloud Partner.
naics.naics_title: Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services
naics.justification: Sysfleet primarily sells workflow automation and compliance consulting services, which fits general management consulting, though its heavy IT/RPA focus could also fit computer systems design.

alternates.naics_title: Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services
alternates.justification: Its RPA and compliance-automation offerings are framed as management/process consulting.
Its core delivery (RPA tools, Microsoft PowerApps/SharePoint/Office 365 systems) is IT systems design and integration.
Some of its automation work involves custom software/programming.

naics.category_justification: Sysfleet is a small for-profit consulting LLC.

naics.resolved_name: Networking and Information Technology Research and Development (NITRD) National Coordination Office
naics.description: The NITRD National Coordination Office (NCO) is a federal office that supports the multi-agency Networking and Information Technology Research and Development Program, coordinating federal R&D efforts in computing, networking, and AI. It is housed within the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy structure and provides staff support, planning, and public-facing RFI coordination for federal AI research strategy. It is a government coordinating body, not an independent agency.
naics.justification: No NAICS code precisely captures a federal interagency R&D-coordination office; this candidate was the closest public-administration research-coordination code available, but the fit is weak.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)
alternates.justification: NITRD's mission is coordinating federal IT and networking research, which is closer to physical/engineering R&D, though NITRD itself performs coordination rather than research directly.
As an office supporting a White House-coordinated program, it has an executive-office administrative character.
The closest available public-administration research-coordination code, though NITRD covers computing/IT rather than space research specifically.

naics.category_justification: NITRD NCO is a federal government coordinating office supporting a multi-agency White House program.

naics.resolved_name: AT&T Services, Inc. (a subsidiary of AT&T Inc.)
naics.description: AT&T Services, Inc. is a subsidiary entity of AT&T Inc., a major American telecommunications company providing wireless, broadband, and wired telecommunications services. AT&T is one of the largest telecommunications carriers in the United States and has been an active commenter on federal AI and technology policy since at least 2019. AT&T Services, Inc. typically serves as AT&T's corporate/regulatory filing entity.
naics.justification: AT&T's primary activity as a corporate group is providing wired and wireless telecommunications services, with AT&T Services, Inc. acting as its regulatory-facing subsidiary.

alternates.justification: AT&T's legacy and largest infrastructure business is wired telecommunications.
AT&T also operates one of the largest US wireless carrier networks.
A general catch-all telecommunications code.

naics.category_justification: AT&T is a publicly traded, for-profit telecommunications corporation.

naics.description: The IEEE Computer Society is a professional membership society of IEEE (Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers) focused on computer science and engineering. It publishes technical journals, develops standards, and offers certifications and conferences for computing professionals. It has commented on federal AI policy through member submissions.
naics.justification: The Computer Society's primary activity is operating a professional membership organization for computing professionals, matching this code.

It offers undergraduate and graduate programs across engineering, sciences, agriculture, business, and other fields, and conducts extensive federally funded research, including in AI and cybersecurity. It is one of Virginia's largest public universities.
naics.justification: The organization's primary activity is degree-granting higher education and university-based research, matching this code.
naics.category_justification: It is an accredited public research university.

naics.resolved_name: Weizenbaum Institute for the Networked Society
naics.description: The Weizenbaum Institute for the Networked Society is a German interdisciplinary research institute based in Berlin, funded by the German Federal Ministry of Education and Research, that studies the digital transformation of society, including AI governance and ethics. It brings together researchers from multiple Berlin-area universities and research organizations. The institute publishes policy-relevant research and engages with policymakers on digital-society issues.
naics.naics_title: Research and Development in the Social Sciences and Humanities
naics.justification: The Institute's primary activity is interdisciplinary social-science research on the impacts of digitalization and AI on society, matching this R&D code.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)
alternates.justification: Some of its research touches technical/engineering aspects of networked systems, but its focus is predominantly social-science oriented.
It is university-affiliated and hosted by partner universities, but is itself a standalone research institute, not a degree-granting body.
It is not a membership professional association.

naics.category_justification: It operates as a publicly funded, independent research institute rather than itself being a degree-granting university or a membership advocacy body.

naics.description: AI2030 is a member-based, nonprofit multistakeholder initiative that promotes responsible AI development through pledges, leadership programs, and collaborative projects among individuals, businesses, investors, and public-sector organizations. It was incubated by FinTech4Good and runs programs such as a Responsible AI Leadership Pledge and a Responsible AI Design Lab. It positions itself as a global convener for responsible AI adoption rather than a research or commercial entity.
naics.justification: AI2030's core activity is convening and coordinating a cross-sector membership around shared responsible-AI commitments, which most closely resembles a professional/multistakeholder membership organization.

alternates.justification: Its mission-driven advocacy for responsible AI could also be classified as social advocacy.
Membership includes businesses and investors, resembling a business association, though it is not industry-specific.

alternates.naics_title: Administrative Management and General Management Consulting Services
alternates.justification: Some of its leadership-institute programming resembles paid training/consulting, but this appears secondary to its convening mission.

naics.category_justification: AI2030 is a membership-based, multistakeholder coalition organized around collective pledges and shared responsible-AI goals, matching this category, though its loose structure creates some ambiguity with nonprofit.

naics.description: Insitro is a machine-learning-driven drug discovery and development company headquartered in South San Francisco, California. It combines biology, data science, and machine learning to identify and develop new therapeutics, partnering with pharmaceutical companies such as Gilead and Bristol Myers Squibb. The company is venture-backed and privately held.
naics.naics_title: Research and Development in Biotechnology (except Nanobiotechnology)
naics.justification: Insitro's primary activity is biotechnology research and drug development using machine learning, matching this R&D code.

alternates.naics_title: Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology)

Insitro is in the discovery/development stage rather than commercial-scale biologic manufacturing.

naics.category_justification: Insitro is a privately held, for-profit biotechnology company commenting in its own commercial capacity.

naics.description: The National Conference of State Legislatures (NCSL) is a bipartisan public officials' association composed of sitting state legislators and legislative staff from all U.S. states, territories, and commonwealths, founded in 1975. It provides research, technical assistance, and a forum for state lawmakers to exchange ideas, and advocates before Congress and federal agencies on behalf of state legislative interests, including on AI policy. NCSL is headquartered in Denver with an additional office in Washington, D.C.
naics.justification: NCSL's primary activity is convening and supporting a membership of state legislators and staff, functioning as a professional/governmental membership association rather than itself administering government programs.

alternates.justification: NCSL's membership and funding are tied to state governments and it performs government-support functions, though it is not itself a government agency.
It functions similarly to a trade association but for legislators rather than businesses.
It engages in advocacy before federal agencies, though its core function is member services and research.

naics.category_justification: NCSL is a membership association of state legislators that represents their collective interests before the federal government, fitting this category despite its close ties to government membership.

It is known for publishing op-eds and policy papers that often align with defense-industry perspectives. It engages with policymakers and the public through published analysis rather than direct lobbying on behalf of clients.

It provides advocacy, education, research, and industry standards for its member companies. MBA engages with federal regulators and Congress on housing finance and lending policy issues, including AI use in underwriting.

naics.description: Connected Nation is a nonprofit organization based in Bowling Green, Kentucky, that works to expand broadband access, adoption, and digital literacy across the United States. It partners with state and local governments, businesses, and community organizations to conduct broadband mapping, digital inclusion programs, and technology training. It engages with federal policymakers on broadband and digital-equity issues.
naics.justification: Connected Nation's primary activity is advocacy and program delivery to expand broadband access and digital equity, which is a social-advocacy/nonprofit mission rather than manufacturing connectors as the candidate list suggested.

alternates.justification: Its community-focused digital-inclusion programs also resemble a civic/social service organization.
